items.title: Meta halts Class C stock issuance pending shareholder litigation resolution
items.summary: Meta Platforms has agreed not to issue Class C common stock during shareholder litigation challenging the company's recapitalization, with trial scheduled to begin April 19, 2027. Mark Zuckerberg waived a requirement under the Founder Alignment Agreement that a previously declared stock dividend be paid within five business days, with the waiver expiring on the earlier of a final resolution of the litigation, June 30, 2027, or a final ruling prohibiting the dividend. The company said it does not expect to launch a previously announced at-the-market program until after the stock dividend is paid.

items.title: Coca-Cola Names David Elkins as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: The Coca-Cola Company announced that David V. Elkins will become Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer effective April 2, 2027, succeeding John Murphy. Murphy, CFO since 2019, will continue as President and intends to retire later in 2027. Elkins, 58, joins from Bristol Myers Squibb where he has served as EVP and CFO since 2019.

items.title: Walt Disney names David Haskett as principal accounting officer
items.summary: Brent A. Woodford, Executive Vice President-Controllership, Financial Planning and Tax and principal accounting officer of Walt Disney, notified the company on November 23, 2026 of his decision to retire. David L. Haskett, age 54, will assume the role of principal accounting officer effective February 15, 2027, while Woodford remains in the position through February 14, 2027 and continues as an employee through June 1, 2027 to support the transition. Haskett currently serves as Senior Controller, Corporate Controllership, a position he has held since May 2022.

items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb appoints Kevin Dillon as new Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb announced that Chief Financial Officer David Elkins will step down on March 1, 2027, to pursue an opportunity outside the pharmaceutical industry. Kevin Dillon, currently Senior Vice President and Head of Corporate Finance and Business Operations, will succeed him as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer effective March 1, 2027. The company reaffirmed its full year 2026 financial guidance.

items.title: Consolidated Edison names Edlyn Misquita as successor controller
items.summary: Joseph Miller, Vice President and Controller of Consolidated Edison and its subsidiary, will retire from the controller role on February 28, 2027, and continue as Vice President of the subsidiary until later that year. Edlyn Misquita, currently Vice President and General Auditor, will succeed Miller as Vice President and Controller effective March 1, 2027; Misquita has been with the company since 2001.

items.title: Visa approves $50 million performance stock option grant to CEO Ryan McInerney
items.summary: Visa's Compensation Committee approved a performance stock option grant to Chief Executive Officer Ryan McInerney on November 18, 2026, covering 378,940 shares with a grant date value of approximately $50 million. The 10-year Performance Option vests upon satisfaction of both performance-vesting conditions based on escalating stock price hurdles of $500, $550, and $600 per share and service-vesting conditions on the third, fourth, and fifth anniversaries of the grant date, subject to continued employment. The award is designed to align the CEO's compensation with the long-term interests of shareholders and encourage his retention.

items.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise reports fiscal 2026 results and raises 2027 guidance.
items.summary: HPE reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $14.5 billion, up 50% year-over-year, with GAAP diluted EPS of $1.26, exceeding guidance. The company raised full-year fiscal 2027 guidance to revenue of $59.4 billion to $63.1 billion (27% to 35% growth) and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $5.05 to $5.35. HPE also approved a $5 billion increase in share repurchase authorization and declared a $0.17 quarterly dividend.

items.title: Keysight Technologies director Charles Dockendorff to retire in December
items.summary: Charles J. Dockendorff informed Keysight's board on November 18, 2026 that he will retire as a director effective December 18, 2026. The board has resolved to reduce its size from 11 to 10 members as of the retirement date. Dockendorff's departure was not due to any disagreement with the company.

items.title: L3Harris Technologies announces optional redemption of $1.25B notes due 2027
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies announced on November 23, 2026 the optional redemption in full of $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount of its 5.400% Notes due 2027. The notes will be redeemed on December 23, 2026 at a redemption price equal to the greater of either the present value of remaining scheduled payments plus 15 basis points or 100% of the principal amount.

items.title: Agilent Technologies Reports Q4 FY2026 Revenue of $2.04 Billion, Raises FY2027 Guidance
items.summary: Agilent reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $2.04 billion, up 9.6% reported and 8.3% core year-over-year, with GAAP EPS of $1.59 up 4% and non-GAAP EPS of $1.86 up 17%. Full-year fiscal 2026 revenue reached $7.55 billion, up 8.7% reported and 6.6% core, with GAAP EPS of $5.15 up 13% and non-GAAP EPS of $6.34 up 13%. The company initiated fiscal 2027 guidance for revenue of $8.00 billion to $8.15 billion, up 6.0% to 8.0% reported, with non-GAAP EPS expected at $6.73 to $6.86.

items.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for approximately $43.9 billion in all-stock deal
items.summary: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valuing the company at approximately $43.9 billion. Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 shares of CrowdStrike common stock for each Zscaler share, representing a 34% premium to Zscaler's closing price on November 20, 2026. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal year 2028, subject to Zscaler shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.

items.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as President and CEO
items.summary: Nvidia's Board of Directors voted unanimously on November 22, 2026, to reinstate Jensen Huang as President, Chief Executive Officer and Board member effective immediately. The Board said it was satisfied with Huang's candor and ability to lead, received input from senior U.S. government officials, and determined his reinstatement poses no national security risk. Colette Kress continues as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

items.title: Prudential Financial elects Jay Wintrob as independent director
items.summary: Prudential Financial's Board of Directors elected Jay Wintrob as an independent director effective January 1, 2027. Wintrob will serve on the Finance Committee and Investment Committee and brings over 40 years of leadership and financial services expertise, most recently as chief executive officer of Oaktree Capital Management.

items.title: PNC Financial Services elects President Mark Wiedman to board of directors
items.summary: PNC Financial Services Group expanded its board to 14 directors and elected Mark Wiedman, who has served as President since May 2025, as a director. The Board also approved a $20 million performance restricted share unit award to Wiedman, vesting over five years based on the company's total shareholder return relative to peers and subject to capital ratio tests.

items.title: American Tower reaches proposed $525 million settlement with DISH and EchoStar
items.summary: American Tower Corporation announced a proposed settlement of litigation against DISH Wireless and EchoStar under which the company expects to receive $525 million in cash on or before December 31, 2026, from an FCC Trust established for spectrum sale transactions. The settlement is subject to execution of a definitive agreement, Bankruptcy Court approval and modification of FCC Trust procedures. The company said it would use settlement proceeds for general corporate purposes including debt reduction, share repurchases and potential mergers and acquisitions.

items.title: Strategy Inc sold shares and bought bitcoin in latest ATM update
items.summary: Strategy Inc sold 1.9 million shares of Class A common stock for $176.7 million in net proceeds during the week ended November 22, 2026. The company used $29.6 million of those proceeds to purchase 457 bitcoin at an average price of $64,898 each, bringing total holdings to 851,305 bitcoin. The board also approved a $1 billion increase in its digital credit securities repurchase program authorization, to $4.0 billion.

items.title: Zscaler posts 20% revenue growth and enters CrowdStrike acquisition deal
items.summary: Zscaler reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $949.3 million, up 20% from $788.1 million a year earlier, with annual recurring revenue growing 21% to $3,882 million. The company announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by CrowdStrike and said it will not hold a conference call or provide forward guidance due to the transaction.
